about: The source model of a TIFF, BigTIFF or OME-TIFF file (TIFF 6.0, spec/zarrify/tiff.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#7-tiff-profile>): the elements a parser emits, the tags of the table it reads, and the roles an IFD, a value, an image or a tile plays, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the TIFF convention's layout. A parser checks this schema while it parses, at the point the profile meets each role; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

kinds.about: the field types a tag of each kind may have (TIFF 6.0 §2, BigTIFF)

tags.about: The tags of the table (spec/zarrify/tiff.md §7.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#71-reading>): kind (the field types allowed), scalar (the first value is read, and there must be one), used (read for every IFD an image uses; ImageDescription only for IFD 0, SubIFDs where followed).

elements.about: The IR of a TIFF file. Names in angle brackets are variables; `run` marks where a parser folds consecutive identically shaped siblings into one run.

ifds/<i>.about: the main chain; each IFD's SubIFDs are subifds/<j> (to depth 4), and the IFDs other pointer tags lead to are exif, gps, interoperability or ifd_<tag> (/<j> when the tag has several values; an IFD read before is an alias)

children.tags/<tag>: struct of entry {tag,type,count[,offset][,field]} and value (in the value field, or at its offset: decoded when the profile reads it, or when small); a duplicate tag is tags/<tag>~<k>
children.tiles/<k>: data (run): a tile of TileOffsets and TileByteCounts with a byte count above 0 within the file; geometry, codec and recipe (a JPEG tile's recipe puts the IFD's JPEG prefix, a shared data source, after its first 2 bytes); an IFD whose tile tables are an earlier IFD's names its tiles by alias
children.strips/<k>: data (run): the same, for StripOffsets and StripByteCounts

ome/planes/<p>.about: an OME-TIFF's plane p (in t, c, z order), the main-chain IFD that holds it (OME-TIFF TiffData)

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: the main chain (each next offset until 0) and the SubIFDs depth first to max_depth; the OME-XML of IFD 0's ImageDescription (ASCII, up to its first NUL, valid UTF-8, with an OME start tag) and its planes by TiffData (spec/zarrify/tiff.md §4.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#41-planes>: the stepping of DimensionOrder); the levels (IFD 0's SubIFDs per plane; else, without OME-XML, each later main-chain IFD that is tiled, has BitsPerSample, the format of IFD 0, and is smaller than the last level in both sizes); the format tuple (bits, samples, sample format, planar, compression, predictor, and photometric for JPEG); the JPEG prefix (an Adobe APP14 marker for 3 samples, then JPEGTables without its SOI and EOI).
